title: Mean time to detect — threat-intel indicator activation (MTTD)
summary: Time between the moment an indicator is published in the upstream STIX 2.1 / TAXII feed and the moment the activated Sigma rule fires on a matching event in the operator's telemetry. Captures the end-to-end intel-to-detection latency that this playbook is designed to compress. Lower is better.

target.rationale: ENISA EU CSIRTs network operational guidance treats intel propagation latency under one hour as a good-practice baseline for high-confidence indicators.

measurement.formula: p95( detection.first_fire_time - intel.published_at ) over indicators matched within the evaluation window, restricted to high-confidence indicators that survived the normalisation step.

inputs.name: intel_published
inputs.description: earliest OCSF event time for the normalised threat-intel inference record carrying the indicator

inputs.name: first_fire
inputs.description: earliest Security Finding event time generated by the Sigma rule activated against the indicator

external_refs.name: ENISA — EU CSIRTs network operational guidance
